title: fix: detect mintty/MSYS2 terminals for colored output
expect: treating mintty/MSYS2 as always interactive breaks piped output: bat would add colors and decorations when stdout is a pipe
quote: Doesn't this mean that when using mintty style terminals, it will always be treated as interactive mode? ... What if the user has aliased `cat` and is piping to another program?
